filename: docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md
---
- [ ] Confirm the release version number and update the version in the `version.py` file.
- [ ] Update the `CHANGELOG.md` with all new features, bug fixes, and breaking changes.
- [ ] Ensure all feature flags are properly documented and enabled/disabled in the release.
- [ ] Verify that all CI/CD pipelines have passed for the latest commit.
- [ ] Run all unit tests and ensure 100% test coverage is achieved.
- [ ] Perform integration testing with core components and external dependencies.
- [ ] Validate backward compatibility with previous versions.
- [ ] Check that all documentation (API, user guides) is updated and reflects the new version.
- [ ] Review and update the release notes for public announcement.
- [ ] Confirm that all dependencies are up to date and compatible with the new version.
- [ ] Test the release build on multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows).
- [ ] Validate that all binaries or packages are correctly built and signed.
- [ ] Ensure the release artifacts (e.g., wheels, source tarballs) are properly archived.
- [ ] Verify that the release is accessible via the official download page.
- [ ] Confirm that the release is tagged in the version control system (e.g., GitHub, GitLab).
- [ ] Check that the release notes are visible in the project’s website or blog.
- [ ] Prepare a release announcement email for the community and stakeholders.
- [ ] Schedule a public announcement on social media (Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub).
- [ ] Notify mailing lists and forums about the new release.
- [ ] Update the project’s website with the new version and release details.
- [ ] Confirm that the release is visible in the project’s release dashboard.
- [ ] Perform a post-release review to gather feedback from early adopters.
- [ ] Update internal tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Asana) with the release status.
- [ ] Document any known issues or limitations in the release notes.
- [ ] Schedule a follow-up meeting to discuss future roadmap and improvements.
